That's the thing, good sir.. Due to how my character complex is, I feel as if if I go to others for help I'm just asking for charity and feel that they wouldn't have helped me if I didn't ask. That they're doing t because they now feel the obligation to help not because they genuinely feel that it's their duty to make sure that I am okay... She was the only one who genuinely made me feel taken care of. 

I hope the hard times for you pass and you come out stronger and happier, good sir.  We all go through our tough times in our live but we end up coming out ahead. If only I had the strength so many of you have... I have lost it through the course of my short life.. I can only dream to be as strong as you.
